data.name: SCARVOID
data.detailed_description:
Scarvoid is a multiplayer action experience built around tense encounters, dangerous environments, powerful abilities, and the constant pressure of survival. Step into a hostile world where every fight can

shift in seconds, every decision carries weight, and victory belongs to the players who can adapt faster than their opponents.

Enter the battlefield alone or alongside others and face unpredictable combat scenarios where positioning, timing, awareness, and teamwork matter as much as raw aggression. Push forward to secure an

advantage, hold your ground when the pressure rises, or take a smarter route through the chaos. Every encounter creates opportunities—but taking them at the wrong moment can be just as dangerous as doing

nothing.

Combat in Scarvoid rewards players who learn their tools and use them with purpose. Make the most of your character’s abilities, react to incoming threats, and choose the right moment to attack, retreat,

support an ally, or turn an enemy’s mistake into your advantage. Powerful attacks can change the course of a fight, but survival requires more than strength. You will need awareness, precision, and the

ability to stay calm when the battlefield stops going according to plan.

The world itself is part of the challenge. Dangerous spaces, shifting situations, and destructive impacts can force you to rethink your strategy at any moment. What looks like a safe position can become a

trap. What seems like a lost fight can become a comeback if you recognize the opening before anyone else does.

Whether you prefer direct confrontation, tactical movement, coordinated team play, or mastering the mechanics needed to outlast your opponents, Scarvoid gives you room to define your own style. Learn from

every match, improve your instincts, and discover new ways to approach combat as you face increasingly skilled competition.

In Scarvoid, there is no room for hesitation. Enter the void, survive the conflict, and prove that you belong among the last ones standing.

data.short_description: Scarvoid is a fast-paced multiplayer action game where survival depends on sharp instincts, powerful abilities, and outplaying your enemies in a hostile, ever-shifting world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor running at 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card with 6 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor running at 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible graphics card with 8 GB VRAM or more
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
